remediation.fix_approach: Added MACRO_NAME_PATTERN (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$/) static constant to GXUtils. Applied validation in selected() to reject non-matching names at entry point, and in onDeleteMacro() to reject before API call. Invalid names show error toast and abort operation.
remediation.root_cause: selected() set selectedMacro = event + '.json' without any validation. onDeleteMacro() passed selectedMacro directly to macroService.deleteMacro() without any allowlist check. sessionStorage macroFileList can be injected by XSS to contain path-traversal sequences (../../../etc/passwd).
changes_made: src/app/macro/macro.component.ts selected(): validates event against MACRO_NAME_PATTERN before storing as selectedMacro
src/app/macro/macro.component.ts onDeleteMacro(): validates macroBaseName against MACRO_NAME_PATTERN; rejects with error toast if invalid
remediation.verification_needed: Test with macro name '../../../etc/passwd' — delete should be blocked with error toast. Test with valid 'my-macro' — delete should proceed normally.
remediation.defense_in_depth: VULN-009 macroFileList clearance on logout reduces the sessionStorage injection window. HTML template already has pattern attribute on macro record input field.
remediation.testing: Test onDeleteMacro() with selectedMacro = '../../../etc/passwd.json' — expect early return with error notification. Test with 'my-macro.json' — expect API call to proceed.
remediation.residual_risk: Medium. Server-side path validation on the ApplinX API is unknown — client-side guard is necessary but should be complemented by server-side validation.
